black.$description: Brand black, the tertiary color for the base and background. It stays pure black, never dark gray (BR-03).

white-soft.$description: Soft white, the body text color on the black page (ADR-0032, TBD-04). It keeps 19.26:1 against black and lets pink and yellow stay the brightest colors.

grey-light.$description: Light grey, the secondary text color (ADR-0032, TBD-05). 11.18:1 against black.

grey-mid.$description: Mid grey, the border color of controls (ADR-0032, TBD-05). 6.25:1 against black.

grey-dark.$description: Dark grey, the color of disabled text and borders (ADR-0032, TBD-05). 3.14:1 against black; disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums.

grey-deep.$description: Deep grey, the color of thin dividers (ADR-0032, TBD-05). 1.85:1 against black; a divider is decorative and exempt.

green.$description: Signal green, the success feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). 10.92:1 against black.

orange.$description: Signal orange, the warning feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). 10.29:1 against black, and clearly not the brand yellow.

red.$description: Signal red, the error feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). 6.94:1 against black.

blue.$description: Signal blue, the info feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). 11.16:1 against black.
